title: Answer: the conscious universe is the one fundamental thing

statements.text: The universe as a whole is fundamental, and it is conscious. On Goff’s field ontology its fundamental fields are very complex universe-wide forms of consciousness, on Nagasawa and Wager’s view cosmic consciousness is the one basic consciousness, and on Shani and Keppler’s it is the zero-point field.

sources.quote: the one and only fundamental individual is the conscious universe
very complex forms of consciousness are the essential nature of the universe-wide fields born by the cosmos
